text:
ana: Heads-up — nightly evals show a 9.8% increase in fabricated citations for long-context summarization on v2-quant builds compared to baseline. Spike started in last deploy window.
sam: Oof. Which prompt sets? samples?
ana: news-longform and legal-briefs. Example from failing run:

sam: ```
Input: Summarize deposition notes (20k tokens)...
Model output (v2-quant): "On May 6, 2019, Dr. X stated ... see Exhibit 12 (clerk's note)." — there is no Exhibit 12 in the context. Baseline model returns "No exhibit referenced."
```

maria: Any recent infra or tokenizer changes in the quant pipeline? We didn't change model weights.
devin: We merged tokenizer normalization changes + v0.9 quant toolchain on the same day. CI had green. I'll check commits.

devin: Quick grep shows commit 8f3b2 changed token merging for rare markers: `merge_rare_tokens=True` and remapped some special tokens to new ids.

a na: That smells like tokenization causing entity blending or mid-token truncation producing plausible but invented references.
sam: Can someone repro locally with the exact quantized artifact used in nightly?

devin: Repro steps I ran:
```
# reproduce with quant artifact
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." \
  "https://nightly.redwood/models/v2-quant/generate" \
  -d '{"input": "<long deposition text>...", "max_tokens": 4000}'
```
Observed same fabricated cite.

a na: I dumped token stream around the phrase. Baseline token ids: `[..., 50256, 334, 78, ...]` vs quant build after merge: `[..., 50256, 32001, 78, ...]` where 32001 maps to a merged byte-level token that wasn't present before.

sam: Can you paste the tokenizer mapping diff?

devin: ```diff
- "<|exhibit|>": 50256
+ "<|exhibit|>": 32001
+ // 32001 is an integer mapping introduced by merge_rare_tokens
```

maria: So the model is now seeing a token that acts like an "exhibit" marker because it was merged with other rare tokens in vocab, and the LM fills in a plausible exhibit number.

a na: This would explain fabricated structured references. It's not the model hallucinating from content absence — it's hallucinating after a token gained higher prior probability during quantized decode.
sam: Good hypothesis. Action plan?

devin: Short-term: revert `merge_rare_tokens` for quant artifacts and rebuild nightly. I'll open a rollback PR and trigger a rebuild now.

devin: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/quant/commit/PR-342 (rolling back merge_rare_tokens). Kicking off build.

ci-bot: Build started for PR-342 on runner-14. Artifacts will land in gs://redwood-nightly/quant/v2-quant/1971234567/

a na: Meanwhile can we add a targeted eval that looks for newly introduced special-token-triggered fabrications? Put in the longform suite.
sam: I'll add a small check that verifies citations/exhibit refs exist in context; failing items will be highlighted.

maria: If revert fixes it, we should add a token-regression test to pre-merge for future tokenizer changes.

devin: Agreed. Also adding a validator that flags when special token ids change across tokenizer releases.

a na: Repro negative test results:
```
- With reverted tokenizer: failure rate drops back to baseline (1.1%).
- With current merged tokenizer: 10.9%.
```

maria: OK once PR build artifacts are ready, can someone run a full nightly smoke with the new artifact and confirm? I want to hold canary if still bad.

devin: Artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-nightly/quant/v2-quant/1971234567/v2-quant-revert.tar.gz
sam: Kicking off canary run now.

sam: Canary finished — metrics: fabricated citations 1.2% (within baseline). No regression on latency.

maria: Thanks. Rolling revert to nightly and tagging a postmortem. Please add timeline and root cause notes to the incident doc.

a na: Root cause summary draft:
- Tokenizer merge (merge_rare_tokens=True) remapped rare/special tokens to new ids.
- New token id collides with patterns used by model to signal structured references; quantized decode amplifies prior probability.
- Result: plausible but fabricated citations inserted in long-context summarization.

sam: Postmortem itemize:
- Rollback complete (devin)
- Add token-id-change validator in CI (devin)
- Add special-token existence checks to eval suites (sam)
- Add canary runs for tokenizer changes before nightly (maria)

devin: Filed follow-ups: https://tickets.redwood/INC-1298

maria: Nice work. :clap:

a na: Will put a short note in release notes for clients using private deployments — tokenizer changes can alter decode behavior.

ops-bot: Scheduled job: nightly-rebuild reverted artifact will be used for next 24h runs.

sam: Closing thread once postmortem doc is linked.

a na: Postmortem: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/tokenizer-merge-citation-fabrication-1971234567

maria: Thanks everyone. Going to monitor next three nights.
